description: Reviews a whole resume of a project, program or product manager, TPM, PMO lead or business analyst, line by line, with rules written by practitioners. Use it when someone shares their resume and asks for a review, feedback, or what to fix before applying. Returns up to 12 lines in the order of risk (unsupported figures, duties with no result, vague claims), each with the finding and the question a hiring manager may ask about it, and the role signals the resume does not show yet. It points at what to fix and does not rewrite lines, so the person's own facts stay their own. English text up to 30000 characters; contact details are removed first; nothing is stored.

resume_text.description: The resume as plain text, copied in full from what the person pasted or from the text of the file they attached. At least the summary and the experience section.
resume_text.title: Resume Text

role.description: Optional. One of project-manager, program-manager, technical-program-manager, product-manager, scrum-master, pmo, it-manager, business-analyst, delivery-manager; a title as written (for example Senior Program Manager) is also read. Empty when not sure.
role.title: Role
